description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, adding {C}{C}.
When Shipwreck Dowser dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shipwreck Dowser on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Shipwreck Dowser from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating five tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Shipwreck Dowser and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers five times and Shipwreck Dowser's second ability triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
